subject.title: WeCom（企业微信）发送消息后 agent 无响应

question: Should this remain open as an OpenClaw-side tracking item until a current WeCom trace proves whether a catalog bump or core fix is needed?
rationale: The report is plausible and aligns with known WeCom delivery-loss history, but the missing environment and logs make it unsafe to close as external-only or to queue a source fix automatically.

options.title: Keep Needs Info
options.body: Keep this open with a request for redacted version, config, and gateway/plugin logs before choosing between an external plugin update and an OpenClaw core fix.

options.title: Redirect External
options.body: Close or redirect only if maintainers decide all WeCom runtime delivery reports without OpenClaw core evidence belong exclusively in WecomTeam/wecom-openclaw-plugin.

options.title: Catalog Bump Review
options.body: Have a maintainer verify a newer WeCom package in a live WeCom setup and then update the official external catalog pin and integrity if it fixes this symptom.

recommendation.title: Keep Needs Info
recommendation.body: Keep this open with a request for redacted version, config, and gateway/plugin logs before choosing between an external plugin update and an OpenClaw core fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The likely OpenClaw-side decision is whether to update the official external plugin catalog once a fixed WeCom package is proven.
